extension-point.name: schedule
extension-point.documentation:
Extension allowing the registration of schedules. This is similar to a cron job. Note that contrary to UNIX cron there is an additional "seconds" field in the cron expression.
A scheduler definition contains information about what job is run, when, and under what identity.
For instance :
Administrator com.example.MyScheduledJob
0 0 3 1 * ? UTC
The class must be an instance of com.hyland.openarch.ecm.core.scheduler.ScheduledJob, having a run() method.
@see org.quartz.CronTrigger @see com.hyland.openarch.ecm.core.scheduler.ScheduledJob @see http://www.quartz-scheduler.org/docs/api/1.8.1/org/quartz/CronExpression.html @see http://www.quartz-scheduler.org/docs/tutorials/crontrigger.html
